title: James Webb reveals a strange bulge in an alien planet's atmosphere
caption:
Astronomers using the James Webb Space Telescope have mapped the lopsided atmosphere of WASP-17b. Powerful winds blow blistering heat around the planet, puffing out one edge into an uneven bulge.

Source: Sciencedaily - James Webb reveals a strange bulge in an alien planet's atmosphere
